ex: an unambitious plan
平实的计划

zh: 一致同意；全体赞同
en: complete agreement about something among a group of people
ex: There is no unanimity of opinion among the medical profession on this subject.
医学界对此问题没有共识。

zh: （决定或意见）一致的，一致同意的
（团体）意见一致的，一致同意某事的
en: if a decision or an opinion is unanimous, it is agreed or shared by everyone in a group
ex: a unanimous vote
全体一致的表决

zh: by everyone in a particular group
en: by everyone in a particular group
ex: The motion was passed unanimously.
动议获一致通过。

zh: 未通知的；未预告的；未打招呼的
en: happening without anyone being told or warned in advance
ex: She just turned up unannounced on my doorstep.
她未打招呼就来到我家门口了。

zh: 无可争辩的；不容反对的
无答案的；无法回答的
en: an unanswerable argument, etc. is one that nobody can question or disagree with
ex: They presented an unanswerable case for more investment.
他们提出了一个无可争辩的理由，要求增加投资。

zh: 未回答的；未解答的；悬而未决的
未回复（或答复）的
en: that has not been answered
ex: Many questions about the crime remain unanswered.
这桩罪行涉及的许多问题仍然没有答案。

zh: 没想到的；未预料到的
en: that you have not expected or predicted
ex: unanticipated costs
预料之外的费用

zh: 不致歉的；不道歉的
en: not saying that you are sorry about something, even in situations in which other people might expect you to

zh: 不致歉的；不道歉的
en: without saying or showing that you are sorry about something, even in situations in which other people might expect you to
ex: The movie was unapologetically romantic.
这部电影绝对浪漫。

zh: 不诱人的；无魅力的；令人不快的
en: not attractive or pleasant
ex: The room was painted in an unappealing shade of brown.
这屋子漆成了难看的棕色。

zh: 难吃的；倒胃口的；看似难吃的
en: unpleasant to eat; looking as if it will be unpleasant to eat
ex: She brought me an unappetizing meal of cold fried eggs on toast.
她给我端来一份冷的煎蛋吐司，看上去就倒胃口。

zh: 无人赏识；不被欣赏；无人感激
en: not having your work or your qualities recognized and enjoyed by other people; not appreciated
ex: He was in a job where he felt unappreciated and undervalued.
他以前的工作未让他感到受赏识和重视。

zh: 不友好的；难接近的；不好说话的
en: not friendly or easy to talk to
ex: Neighbours described the man as being difficult and unapproachable.
邻居形容这个人很困难，也无法接近。

zh: 无可争辩的；不容置疑的
en: that nobody can disagree with
ex: unarguable proof
不容置疑的证据

zh: 无可争辩的；不容置疑的
en: in a way that nobody can disagree with
ex: She is unarguably one of the country's finest athletes.
她无疑是全国最优秀的运动员之一。

zh: 不带武器的；非武装的
不使用武器的；徒手的
en: not carrying a weapon
ex: unarmed civilians
没有武装的平民

zh: involving only one member of a set at a time
en: involving only one member of a set at a time

zh: 不害臊的；不感觉难为情的；恬不知耻的
en: not feeling ashamed or embarrassed about something, especially when people might expect you to
ex: She talked openly about her unashamed love of money.
她公开谈论自己对金钱的不懈追求。

zh: 不害臊的；不感觉难为情的；恬不知耻的
en: without feeling or showing you are ashamed or embarrassed about something, especially when people might expect you to be
ex: She wept unashamedly.
她不顾羞耻地哭了起来。

zh: 没发问的；未出口的
未获邀请的；未经要求的
en: an unasked question is one that you have not asked even though you would like to know the answer
ex: He came to the party unasked.
他未经邀请就来参加聚会了。

zh: 未经要求的；非请求的
en: that has not been asked for or requested
ex: unasked-for advice
主动提出的建议

zh: 无法摧毁的；不可战胜的；不容置疑的
en: that cannot be destroyed, defeated or questioned
ex: The party now has an unassailable lead.
这个党的领先地位现在坚不可摧。

zh: 未分配的；未保留的
en: not given to or reserved for any particular person or purpose

zh: 无人帮助的；不靠外援的；独力的
en: not helped by anyone or anything
ex: She could not move unassisted.
她不能够独力活动。

zh: 不爱出风头的；不爱炫耀的；谦逊的
en: not wanting to draw attention to yourself or to your abilities or status
ex: He did some wonderful work in a quiet and unassuming way.
他一声不响、不事张扬地干了一些漂亮活儿。

zh: 未婚的；单身的；未恋爱的
不属于团体或组织的；无所属的；无党派的；独立的
en: not married or involved in a romantic relationship
ex: He was still unattached at the age of 34.
他 34 岁时还是单身。

zh: 无法得到的；难以达到的
en: impossible to achieve or reach
ex: an unattainable goal
难以达到的目标

zh: 主人不在场的；无人看管（或照料）的
en: without the owner present; not being watched or cared for
ex: unattended vehicles
无人看管的车辆

zh: 不悦目的；不漂亮的；难看的
不好的；无趣的；令人反感的
en: not attractive or pleasant to look at
ex: an unattractive brown colour
难看的棕色
